description: Head-movement mini-game G16: a yes/no quiz answered by head motion only. Ten fixed everyday questions in fixed order; a gentle nod answers YES (nod event primary, pitch fallback), a single side turn past 27 degrees held 0.8 seconds answers NO (no shake gesture exists or is claimed); 10 seconds per question, return to center required before the next question, TTS reads every question and verdict. No camera, no mic/ASR.
name: nod-quiz
